title: 第十五章宝物神像的下落第十六章五百文的拜门费开元丹一两三枚
slug: 玄幻乱世猎户从箭术到人间武圣
content_zh:
被挡住了去路，顾晦心往下一沉。
“这位大人，还有事？”
他往后退了两步，表情镇定地问道。
护山队的衙役负责巡山，并非负责命案的六扇门衙役，顾晦不觉得他们是为了追查杀刀疤六的凶手而出现在此，刀疤六还没有那样的牌面，所以，他并没有慌乱。
“把背篓里的东西倒出来，我们要检查……”
班头努了努嘴，态度傲慢。
检查？
雁过拔毛么？
“好的，大人！”
顾晦点了点头，取下背篓，把里面的猎物全都倒了出来，整个背篓变得空空荡荡。
“顾晦，例行公事而已！”
先前认出顾晦的护山队成员笑着对顾晦说道，顾晦仔细看了他一眼，这才认出了对方。
这个人和父亲顾长青是称兄道弟的好朋友，来顾家做过客，和顾长青喝过酒。
班头低着头，仔细检查背篓。
就连猎物也没有放过，他抽出横刀，剖开了野兔和松鸡的肚腹检查了一番。
“彭叔，这是为啥？”
顾晦站在那个人身边，轻声问道。
“你爹昨天不是出事了么？把你爹打伤的扑天鹤朱权逃进了大青山，现在还在山里面没有出来，那家伙从郡城某个世家那里偷了一件宝贝，所以……”
彭威轻声说了一句。
之后，他又指了指地上的猎物，问道：“大侄子，这些都是你射杀的？”

顾晦点了点头。
“箭术不错哦，第一次进山就有这些收获，当初，你爹在酒桌上还时常抱怨，说是子不能承父业，看来，你爹也不知道自己儿子的本事……”
彭威笑了笑，不过，笑容很快在他脸上消失。
“你爹啊，运气不好！”
他叹了口气。
“彭叔，什么宝贝？”
“难不成还能藏在野兔的肚子里？”
顾晦轻声问道。
“说是一个三头六臂的神像，捡到这玩意上交的话，有五百两的赏银……”
彭威的声音变得更轻了。
五百两？
顾晦的心一动。
若是得到这神像，换来五百两赏银，父亲的腿也就能够治好了，家里也不必为生活发愁。
不过，他很快按下了念头。
如果，神像现在在他手里。
他若是上交给这些人，又或者被这些人在搜查中找到，接下来，将会发生什么事情呢？
他用脚都能想到。
五百两肯定是没有的，自己能不能保住性命纯粹看运气，有极大的可能会被失踪。
“好啦，你可以走了！”
班头检查完毕，没有发现神像，他看了顾晦一眼，朝他摆了摆手，示意他快滚。
content_en:
Being blocked, Gu Hui's heart sank.
"My lord, is there anything else?"
He took two steps back and asked calmly.
The yamen of the mountain guard team were responsible for patrolling the mountain, not the 6-door yamen responsible for murder cases. Gu Hui didn't think they were here to track down the murderer of Scar Liu. Scar Liu didn't have such a card yet, so he didn't panic.
"Put out the contents of the backpack, we need to check..."
The class leader pursed his lips and showed an arrogant attitude.
examine?
Have geese ever plucked their feathers?
"Okay, sir!"
Gu Hui nodded, took off the backpack, and poured out all the prey inside. The entire backpack became empty.
"Gu Hui, it's just a routine matter!"
The member of the mountain protection team who recognized Gu Hui earlier said to Gu Hui with a smile. Gu Hui looked at him carefully and then recognized him.
This man and his father, Gu Changqing, were good friends who were brothers. He came to Gu's house as a guest and drank with Gu Changqing.
The class leader lowered his head and carefully checked the backpack.
Not even the prey was spared. He drew out his horizontal knife and cut open the bellies of the hares and grouse for inspection.
"Uncle Peng, why is this?"
Gu Hui stood beside the man and asked softly.
"Didn't something happen to your father yesterday? Zhu Quan, the Flying Crane who injured your father, escaped into Daqing Mountain and is still in the mountain. That guy stole a treasure from a certain family in the county, so..."
Peng Wei said softly.
After that, he pointed to the prey on the ground and asked: "Eldest nephew, did you shoot these?"
Gu Hui nodded.
"My archery skills are pretty good. I got these results the first time I entered the mountains. At the beginning, your father often complained at the wine table, saying that his son could not inherit his father's legacy. It seems that your father did not know his son's ability..."
Peng Wei smiled, but the smile quickly disappeared from his face.
"Your dad, you're out of luck!"
He sighed.
"Uncle Peng, what treasure?"
"Is it possible that it can still be hidden in the belly of a hare?"
Gu Hui asked softly.
"It's said to be a statue of a god with three heads and six arms. If you pick this thing up and turn it in, there will be a reward of five hundred taels of silver..."
Peng Wei's voice became softer.
Five hundred taels?
Gu Hui's heart moved.
If I get this statue in exchange for a reward of five hundred taels of silver, my father's leg will be cured, and the family will not have to worry about life.
However, he quickly thought about it.
If, the idol is in his hand now.
If he is handed over to these people, or is found by these people during a search, what will happen next?
He can think of it with his feet.
There is definitely no five hundred taels. Whether he can save his life depends purely on luck. There is a high possibility that he will be disappeared.
"Okay, you can go!"
The squad leader finished the inspection and found no statue. He glanced at Gu Hui and waved his hand to him, telling him to get out.
